correctness.rationale: Directly checked the definition: a zero needs adjacent 3 or two adjacent 2s; a 1 needs adjacent >=2; an isolated positive may only be 2. For a total weight <=6 and n>=4, any layer weight <=2 forces too much weight in matched opposite-layer vertices, hence layer weights >=3. At equality each layer weight 3 cannot be 2+1 (remaining zeros demand >=2 in opposite layer) nor 1+1+1 (zeros or unsupported 1s); each layer has a unique 3. Nonisolated-positive condition forces matched indices. Independently exhausted all 4^8=65,536 labelings for n=4 and all 4^10=1,048,576 for n=5: respective optima 6 with exactly 4 and 5 matching minima. Analytic lower bound covers all n>=4.
